description: The fraction of battles with at least one scored success within 15 rounds.
label: ASR@15

description: The rate at which the perturbed model produces different answers from the original model, e.g., 36.0% on USMLE questions.
label: Answer change rate

description: The fraction of battles in which the attacker succeeds, as determined by scenario-specific checks.
label: Attack Success Rate (ASR)

description: The ability of ISOLATEGPT to protect against attacks from the benchmark and safety issues caused by imprecision of language.
label: Attack protection

description: The proportion of attacks that successfully compromise the system.
label: Attack success rate

description: Measures the utility of the agent under adversarial evaluations.
label: Attack utility

description: Measures the utility of the agent for its intended functions under benign conditions.
label: Benign utility

description: The rate at which the attack successfully bypasses defenses or induces unsafe endorsement or risky execution.
label: Bypass rate

description: Time taken to compile skills, measured in milliseconds.
label: Compilation latency

description: A calculated score based on the interplay of precision, recall, and false positive count.
label: Composite score

description: Ability to foresee market turbulence or crashes.
label: Crash foresight

description: The mean outcome of episodes, where 1 indicates optimal policy (win), 0.966 indicates near-optimal, etc.
label: Episode outcome mean

description: A metric measuring the accuracy of the agent's answers as judged by experts.
label: Expert Accuracy

description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for detecting harmful content using knowledge graphs.
label: F1 score

description: The number of false positive findings.
label: False positive count

description: Whether ISOLATEGPT provides the same functionality as the baseline VANILLAGPT for all benchmarks.
label: Functionality equivalence

description: Percentage of harmful content identified by the knowledge graph screening method.
label: Harmful content capture rate

description: Proportion of LLM-generated outputs that are medically harmful, as judged by clinicians.
label: Harmful content rate

description: The rate at which the attack enables jailbreaking, improved from 2% to 58% for Llama-3-instruct.
label: Jailbreak success rate

description: Proportion of cases where the model failed to detect a lesion.
label: Lesion miss rate

description: Ability to contain cascading losses during market stress.
label: Loss containment

description: Proportion of cases where the model correctly identified the organ.
label: Organ detection rate

description: Percentage of tasks successfully completed, used to measure performance improvements.
label: Pass rate

description: The additional time or resources incurred by ISOLATEGPT compared to VANILLAGPT, measured as a percentage. Under 30% for 75.73% of tested queries.
label: Performance overhead

description: The proportion of true positive findings among all positive findings.
label: Precision

description: Percentage of security vulnerabilities detected and blocked by the Security Optimizer.
label: Proactive security trigger rate

description: Ability to react rapidly to market shocks.
label: Reaction

description: The proportion of true positive findings among all actual positives.
label: Recall

description: Ability to recover after stress events.
label: Recovery

description: Percentage reduction in token usage during runtime across frameworks.
label: Runtime token savings

description: Security metric for attacks on market-relevant information sources (e.g., data or news manipulation).
label: S1: Attacks on information sources

description: Security metric for direct attacks on LLM trading agents (e.g., prompt injection, tool/API exploitation, memory manipulation).
label: S2: Attacks on agents

description: Security metric for scenarios where compromised agents act as attackers, injecting perturbations that can propagate market-wide.
label: S3: Agent-as-attacker behaviors

description: A metric measuring the proportion of questions where the agent's answer strictly meets all criteria for success.
label: Strict Success Rate

description: The performance of the system in completing tasks, measured as a percentage.
label: Utility

description: The percentage of episodes where the defenders win, used to evaluate performance under reduced alert success probability.
label: Win rate
